Palette: cool carbon gray and subdued blue with quartermaster's restrained amber accent. Soft side lighting, subtle cool rim light, grounded mature tone.
Constraints: exactly four people, one per quadrant. No readable text, names, symbols, logos, emblems, watermark, UI, weapons or fantasy ornament. No outside margin. Every quadrant is a clean square portrait region suitable for AtlasTexture.
